wrong_findings.claim: Every page has a viewport meta tag.
wrong_findings.why_wrong: `/visit/` has no `<meta name="viewport">`; its supplied HTML confirms the planted missing-viewport issue.

extra_true.finding: The site lacks Open Graph and Twitter card tags and a favicon reference; the favicon path is absent.
The cafe has no LocalBusiness/CafeOrCoffeeShop structured data; the homepage only has Organization markup.
Product structured data is absent on Flores Bajawa, gift box and limited release, and existing Product blocks lack some properties the audit names.
The blog index links only two posts, leaving the cold-brew post discoverable through page 2; the audit recommends stronger links.
The shop page is a short text-only page with links and no product images or prices.
Real 404 responses use the server's default unbranded error page, according to the audit's observed crawl.
The audit notes missing breadcrumbs, thin footer navigation, absent visible blog author bylines/dates, and a short homepage.

notes: Scored against the 20 planted issues; issue 1 is absent, and issue 11 is missed while the audit incorrectly says every page has a viewport tag. Count is approximate, splitting clearly separate listed problems while counting duplicate mentions once.
